Single-Elimination Bracket |tournaments=2on2 |prizepool=Fame & Glory |entrance= |website= https://discord.gg/6PqHGSZ |website3=hammer-time.quake1.pl/ |sdate=2023-01-08 |year=2023 |edate= |twitch= |youtube= |teamfirst=Poisonous and Venomous |teamfirstflag=sefi |teamsecond=Firing Squad |teamsecondflag=eu |teamthird=DM Riders |teamthirdflag=eu |teamthird2= |teamfourth= |teamfourthflag= |map1=dm2 |map2=dm4 |map3=dm6 |map4=aerowalk |map5=ztndm3 |map6=bravado |map7=shifter }} {{Tabs static |name1=Overview |link1=Time 2 Hammer Season 4 |name2=Playoffs |link2=Time 2 Hammer Season 4/Playoffs |name3=Division 1 |link3=Time 2 Hammer Season 4/Div1A |name4=Division 2 |link4=Time 2 Hammer Season 4/Div2A |This=1 }} TIME2HAMMER is semi-professional QuakeWorld 2on2 league founded by {{player|hammer|flag=pt}} in 2019. European players of all skill levels will be able to participate, however, non-European players are free to sign up as long as they play their matches in Europe with the lowest pings possible. TIME2HAMMER joins all players together with an extensive map pool and each year a new map is selected. Each player is assigned to one of several groups. The league is based on the Round Robin system in which each team will play against every other participant in their group. ===Division 1 Winners=== {{PrizepoolSEnoprize |number=16 |width= |playerwidth=140 |bronzematch= |date=March, 20, 2023 - 20:00 {{Abbr|CEST|(UTC+2)}} |p1=Poisonous and Venomous |f1=sefi |p2=Firing Squad |f2=eu |p3=DM Riders |f3=eu |p4=FIFI |f4=fi |p5=tSQ |f5=se |p6=ZENTAR |f6=pl |p7=Karramba |f7=pl |p8=AeronautS |f8=se |p9=NME |f9=se |p10=eSports |f10=eu |p11=Jägarna |f11=se |p12=Fire |f12=eu |p13=Sjundeå Quake Club |f13=fi |p14=2xP |f14=pl |p15=Lakad Matatag |f15=se |p16=shub life|f16=us }} ===Division 2 Winners=== {{PrizepoolSEnoprize |number=15 |width= |playerwidth=140 |bronzematch= |date=March, 20, 2023 - 20:00 {{Abbr|CEST|(UTC+2)}} |p1=kis-kis |f1=ru |p2=Trivial Pursuit |f2=se |p3=FUkken Aye |f3=fi |p4=Szansa |f4=pl |p5=Jeu de cons |f5=fr |p6=Drowned Kittens|f6=eu |p7=Evil Twins |f7=eu |p8=plus forward |f8=pl |p9=grubasy |f9=pl |p10=m00 |f10=gb |p11=Fallen Angels |f11=dk |p12=Cienkie Siurki|f12=pl |p13=washed-up speedboys |f13=eu |p14=NurafenTeam|f14=eu |p15=Blood Runners |f15=eu |p16=- |f16=tbd }} == Format == * 2on2 * Round robin group stage ** {{Abbr|Go4|Game of 4}} matches ** 1 match per week == Rules == * Timelimit 10 minutes. * Overtime 3 minutes. * DMM3. * No powerups. * Discharges on. * No fairpacks. * Ktpro spawns (unless both players agree on a different mode). * sv_maxfps 77. * No berzerk, midair, instagib or other unusual modes. * Fallbunny on (unless both players agree play with off). * Spectators are allowed by default but if ONE player DOESN’T AGREE then MUST BE changed to NO SPECTATORS.
